name: Mirage Arcane

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Up to a square mile of terrain looks, sounds, smells and feels like other terrain for 10 days.
text: The illusion is solid enough to touch and can make ground Difficult Terrain or block movement; structures can be changed or added, but not creatures. Creatures with Truesight see the real terrain but still interact with the illusion.
